# PeakAndPack Test Cases (UI Agent)

**Phase:** 3, Approach D, AI Agent
**Based on:** `peakandpack-requirements.md` (Phase 1), generated by `ui-testcase-agent.js`, reviewed by RN
**Author:** Claude (Anthropic), via the UI test case generator prompt, reviewed by RN

---

## How this differs from the manual and manual+AI sets

Same source document as `test-cases-manual.md` and `test-cases-ai-assisted.md`, but this table was produced by running `ui-testcase-agent.js` non-interactively against `peakandpack-requirements.md`, with no back-and-forth conversation and no chance to nudge the model mid-draft. The prompt fixes the model's scope to user-facing UI behaviour only: what a person clicks, types, and sees, never a raw status code or a request payload. Everything below is the agent's first table, then the same review pass every other approach in this series gets.

## What the review pass changed

| Change | Why |
|---|---|
| Corrected TC-U04's expected result to flag SAVE10 as a 10 percent discount, not accept whatever the app currently does | The requirements are the source of truth, not the current build. The agent draft correctly followed the requirements; the review pass confirmed it rather than "fixing" it to match the live bug (BUG-009). |
| Added TC-U11, the negative-price display case | Found by inspecting the live product catalog during Phase 0-3 verification: "Sleeping Bag (-15C)" is listed at **-$89.00**. The requirements don't call this out directly, so this row is flagged ASSUMPTION and was added by hand. |
| Removed four duplicate "empty field" cases across Auth and Search | The draft generated near-identical empty-input cases per field; kept one representative case per feature area, same trim as the manual set. |
| Reworded TC-U08 to require login before viewing cart | The draft assumed cart was viewable anonymously. The requirements state cart operations require authentication; the agent missed this because "requires authentication" appears in the API section, not spelled out for the UI. Corrected by hand. |

## Test cases (after review)

### Products

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-U01 | Product list loads | Open the home page | Every product shows a name, price, category, and stock count | High |
| TC-U02 | Search returns matches | Type "tent" into the search box, click Search | Only products with "tent" in the name or description are shown | Medium |
| TC-U03 | Search with no matches | Search for a term that matches nothing | An empty result, not an error message | Medium |
| TC-U11 | Negative price display | View a product priced below zero | ASSUMPTION: a price should never render as negative; this needs a product-team decision on whether it's a display bug or a data bug | Medium |

### Cart

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-U08 | Cart requires login | Visit the cart page while logged out | Prompted to log in, cart contents are not shown | Critical |
| TC-U04 | Add item to cart | Click "Add to cart" on any product, then open the cart | The item appears in the cart with the correct price | High |
| TC-U05 | Cart total updates | Add two different items to the cart | The cart's total equals the sum of both item prices | High |
| TC-U06 | Remove item from cart | Remove an item from a cart with two items | The item disappears and the total recalculates | Medium |

### Checkout

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-U07 | Checkout with discount code | Add an item, enter SAVE10 on the checkout page, place the order | Total shown is reduced by exactly 10 percent | Critical |
| TC-U09 | Checkout with empty cart | Reach the checkout page with nothing in the cart | Blocked from placing an order, with a clear message | High |
| TC-U10 | Order confirmation shown | Complete a checkout | A confirmation screen appears naming the order | Critical |

### Auth

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-U12 | Register new account | Fill in name, email, and password, submit | Account created, user is signed in | Critical |
| TC-U13 | Register with blank name | Submit registration with the name field empty | ASSUMPTION: the requirements don't explicitly say the UI must block this, but a blank name should be rejected before submission, not just server-side (see BUG-006) | Medium |
| TC-U14 | Login with wrong password | Enter a correct email with an incorrect password | A clear error message, not signed in | Critical |

### Orders

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-U15 | View own order history | Log in and open the orders page | Only this user's past orders are listed | High |

## Review note

This is agent-generated, then reviewed, not agent-authored and shipped as-is. The agent's biggest miss was TC-U08: it drafted a cart test with no login step because the requirements state the authentication rule once, in the API section, and the UI-only framing of the prompt made the model treat it as out of scope. That's a real limitation worth knowing about this approach: a script running one prompt in one pass has no way to cross-reference a rule stated in a different section unless the review pass catches it.
